name: Samuels Group
description: The Samuels Group partners with municipalities across Wisconsin to plan, build, and furnish facilities that serve their communities. From concept through completion, we provide design, construction, commercial furniture solutions, and in-house estimating all under one roof. Our Special Projects team specializes in renovations, repairs, and facility improvements, with a practical understanding of the small budgets, tight schedules, and flexible off-hours work often needed to keep municipal facilities operating with minimal disruption.

name: Scherrer Construction
description: Trusted since 1928, Scherrer Construction provides end-to-end construction management and general contractor services through superior craftsmanship and custom solutions for municipalities throughout Wisconsin. Scherrer excels in municipal building construction that supports community values, ensuring durability and functionality that serve public needs for generations to come.

name: Service Line Program by HomeServe
description: Service Line Program by HomeServe is the trusted leader in residential repair service plans. The company partners with over 1,300 municipalities and utilities across North America, delivering peace of mind to more than 4.6 million customers through over 9.6 million protection plans. In the last five years alone, HomeServe has completed over 2 million repair jobs, saving homeowners more than $1 billion. To learn more about how this program can bring revenue and peace of mind to your community, please get in touch with mike.chambers@homeserveusa.com

name: Short Elliott Hendrickson, Inc (SEH)
description: SEH is an employee-owned collective of engineers, architects, planners, and scientists that helps government, commercial, and industrial clients find solutions to succeed in today's world. We’re simplifying the world’s complex challenges by improving mobility, designing better places, engineering clean water, and renewing infrastructure. Together, we are committed to Building a Better World for All of Us®.

name: Sprinter
description: Sprinter is a security-first technology partner that helps organizations simplify and strengthen their IT environments through managed IT services, cybersecurity, compliance support, cloud solutions, communications, and physical security. Serving businesses, government agencies, schools, and organizations throughout Wisconsin and beyond, Sprinter provides practical guidance, accountable support, and integrated technology solutions designed to reduce risk, improve operations, and help clients move forward with confidence.

name: State of WI Board of Commissioners of Public Lands
description: BCPL provide municipal loans for public works projects.

name: Strand Associates, Inc.
description: We have been providing exceptional civil and environmental engineering service to clients since 1946. We attribute our organizational strength to our talented engineers, effective management, and, most of all, commitment to nurturing long-term client relationships. Our Corporate Mission states we are “dedicated to helping clients succeed through excellence in engineering.” In accordance with this mission, we are continually expanding our staff and service offerings to broaden our base of experience and knowledge so that we can provide more creative solutions to meet the evolving needs of each client. To serve our client base efficiently, we have twelve offices nationwide.

name: The Alliance
description: The Alliance serves as the voice for self-funded employers who want more control over their healthcare costs. Using Smarter Networks and sophisticated data mining and analysis, they provide transparent, creative approaches to network and benefit plan design to unlock savings where others can’t – or won’t. The Alliance remains a trusted, objective partner for its 500+ employers and their brokers who seek improved access to high-quality healthcare by contracting with a network of healthcare providers and doctors across the Midwest.

name: The Office Technology Group
description: With 35 years of loyalty to our vast client base, our focus is on providing customized solutions that address our customers’ unique business needs. From impressive digital imaging to state-of-the-art digital displays, IT support, and managed print services, The Office Technology Group offers a wide variety of products and services for your company. We provide the latest technologies and services with our impressive line of products, giving your company increased efficiency, custom-designed to work with your budget.

name: Trotter and Associates, Inc.
description:
Trotter and Associates, Inc. is a full-service engineering firm specializing in municipal infrastructure development and rehabilitation. Trotter and Associates, Inc. is structured to meet the growing needs of our clients. TAI provides planning, design and construction engineering services to municipal, institutional and other governmental agencies.

Our professional staff includes engineers, construction managers, inspectors and drafting technicians. The team realizes the importance of developing strong client/consultant relationships and strives to earn each client’s confidence, trust and respect through exceptional service. Trotter and Associates, Inc. is a civil engineering firm that is making a difference through setting a higher standard.

name: USG Water Solutions
description:
Utility Service Group Water Solutions (USG) has a 60-year history as the industry leader in providing asset management and rehabilitation services to municipal and private water companies across the United States.

Our industry-leading services help municipalities maintain their water and wastewater infrastructure by increasing asset performance, simplifying operations and minimizing maintenance costs.

name: UW-Madison Extension
description: UW–Madison Extension brings the Wisconsin Idea to every corner of the state. Extension works closely with communities on complex problems that require unbiased, research-based information, developing educational programming to address real-world issues. Extension’s statewide network of educators and specialists delivers services through local collaborations and relationships to develop practical applications of research, while also using community input to inform future studies.

name: Vierbicher
description: Vierbicher helps municipalities grow, develop, and revitalize. We offer integrated services including planning, design, funding, and implementation of projects. Technical expertise includes: municipal engineering, planning, community development, urban design, landscape architecture, water resources, surveying, and GIS.

name: Wildcard Corp
description: Wildcard is a team-driven and customer focused technology company with extensive experience in development, hosting, and security. We collaborate closely with our clients to produce secure, functionally rich, custom solutions.

name: Wisconsin Association of Local Health Departments and Boards
Wisconsin Housing Alliance
description:
Factory-built homes are a solution for affordable,
high-quality, and energy-efficient community
development.

As housing costs rise and construction timelines
lengthen, factory-built housing offers a scalable,
flexible approach to expanding homeownership —
when paired with the right policies, partners, and
financing strategies.

name: Wisconsin Surplus Online Auction
description: We are an online auction company that helps municipalities sell their surplus equipment, vehicles, real estate, and more with NO sellers fee!

name: Zimmerman Architectural Studios
description:
We know that a building project is an immense undertaking and a significant financial commitment – but at the core of it all, it marks a new chapter.
Building design is an investment in your organization’s future, and the right partner advances your vision into something tangible and timeless.

For us, it’s more than a beautiful building. It’s an investment in your future. We believe in architecture as a catalyst for promoting wellness, facilitating dialogue, advancing missions, inspiring learning and enriching lives.

We are laser-focused on developing relationships with our clients, immersing ourselves in your operations and delivering high-quality design.
